meta.name: newsletter-monetization-planner
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "monetize my newsletter", "build a sponsorship rate card", or "model paid-subscription revenue"; produces a revenue model (paid tiers, ad/sponsorship inventory + CPM/flat rate card, referral/boost loops), a list-growth ↔ revenue projection, and honest-offer / disclosure checks for the SEND-D lever. Not for scoring the whole program or running D1 — use email-quality-auditor; not for the return math — use roi-calculator; not for the post-click page — use landing-optimizer. 邮件newsletter变现/赞助刊例/付费订阅测算

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划邮件通讯的变现方案与收入模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你运营邮件通讯并想设计付费订阅或广告收入模式。
copy.tagline_en: Plan monetization strategies and revenue models for your newsletter.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a newsletter and want to design paid tiers or ad revenue models.

howto.what: Claude 会帮你规划邮件列表的变现方案，包括付费订阅、广告赞助和推荐增长，并生成收入模型、增长预测和合规检查清单。
howto.when: 当你要求“为我的newsletter变现”、“制定赞助刊例”或“测算付费订阅收入”时触发。

say.text: 为我的2万订阅者newsletter规划付费订阅和赞助收入。
帮我制定一个赞助刊例，基于4.5万列表、42%打开率。
say.note: Claude 会输出CPM或固定费率的刊例表。

say.text: 对比纯付费订阅和混合模式（订阅+赞助）的收入预测。
say.note: Claude 会生成两种方案的增长与收入投影。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you plan monetization for your newsletter, including paid subscriptions, ad/sponsorship inventory, and referral growth loops, producing a revenue model, growth-to-revenue projection, and disclosure checklist.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "monetize my newsletter", "build a sponsorship rate card", or "model paid-subscription revenue".

say_en.text: Plan paid tiers and sponsorships for my 20,000-subscriber newsletter.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for list size, open rate, etc., then generate a revenue model.

say_en.text: Build a sponsorship rate card for a 45K list at 42% open rate.
say_en.note: Claude will output a CPM or flat rate card table.

say_en.text: Compare a paid-sub-only vs a hybrid (subs + sponsorship) plan.
say_en.note: Claude will project revenue for both scenarios.
